fertilizer_recommendation: Avoid excess nitrogen; apply balanced NPK and compost to improve plant vigor.
pesticide_recommendation: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2.5g/L or Chlorothalonil 75 WP @ 2g/L water.
organic_option: Foliar spray of Trichoderma harzianum @ 5g/L or 1% Bordeaux mixture.
application_method: Thorough foliar spray at the first sign of lower leaf spotting
safety_note: Follow the product label and confirm the dose with your local agriculture officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra before spraying.

fertilizer_recommendation: Apply micronutrient mixtures with zinc and boron to mitigate viral stress.
pesticide_recommendation: Control whitefly vector with Imidacloprid 17.8 SL @ 0.3ml/L or Thiamethoxam 25 WG @ 0.3g/L.
organic_option: Install yellow sticky traps (15 traps/acre); spray 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE).
application_method: Early morning foliar spray targeting leaf undersides where whiteflies shelter
safety_note: Follow the product label and confirm the dose with your local agriculture officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra before spraying.

fertilizer_recommendation: Apply bleaching powder @ 10-15 kg/ha before planting; maintain neutral soil pH.
pesticide_recommendation: Soil drenching with Streptocycline (200 ppm) + Copper Oxychloride @ 2.5g/L.
organic_option: Soil application of Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 2.5 kg/ha enriched in farmyard manure.
dosage: 1g Streptocycline + 25g Copper Oxychloride in 10 liters of water
application_method: Root zone drenching around affected and surrounding plants
safety_note: Follow the product label and confirm the dose with your local agriculture officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra before spraying.

fertilizer_recommendation: Balanced potash application (120 kg/ha K2O) to increase tuber and foliage resistance.
pesticide_recommendation: Spray Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP (Ridomil) @ 2.5g/L or Cymoxanil + Mancozeb @ 2g/L.
organic_option: Prophylactic spray of copper hydroxide @ 2g/L or Bacillus subtilis bio-fungicide.
application_method: Uniform canopy spray covering both upper and lower leaf surfaces
safety_note: Follow the product label and confirm the dose with your local agriculture officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra before spraying.

fertilizer_recommendation: Maintain adequate nitrogen and potassium; avoid water deficit stress.
pesticide_recommendation: Spray Chlorothalonil 75 WP @ 2g/L or Propiconazole 25 EC @ 1ml/L.
organic_option: Spray Neem oil (1500 ppm) @ 5ml/L or fermented butter milk (Chhachh) spray.
application_method: Foliar application repeated after 10-12 days if disease persists
safety_note: Follow the product label and confirm the dose with your local agriculture officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra before spraying.

fertilizer_recommendation: Avoid split doses of high nitrogen; top-dress silicon and potassium fertilizers.
pesticide_recommendation: Foliar spray with Tricyclazole 75 WP @ 0.6g/L or Isoprothiolane 40 EC @ 1.5ml/L.
organic_option: Seed treatment with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10g/kg seed; foliar spray @ 2.5g/L.
application_method: Spray at tillering and boot leaf emergence stages
safety_note: Follow the product label and confirm the dose with your local agriculture officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra before spraying.

fertilizer_recommendation: Drain standing water immediately; withhold top-dressing of nitrogen.
pesticide_recommendation: Spray Copper Hydroxide 77 WP @ 2g/L mixed with Streptocycline @ 0.1g/L.
organic_option: Foliar spray of fresh cow dung slurry supernatant (20%) or bioagent P. fluorescens.
dosage: 2g Copper Hydroxide + 0.1g Streptocycline per liter of water
application_method: Fine mist spray across affected field strips
safety_note: Follow the product label and confirm the dose with your local agriculture officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra before spraying.

fertilizer_recommendation: Avoid excessive urea in late stages; supplement with micronutrient zinc.
pesticide_recommendation: Foliar spray with Propiconazole 25 EC (Tilt) @ 1ml/L or Tebuconazole 25.9 EC @ 1ml/L.
organic_option: Sow certified rust-resistant varieties; spray Trichoderma viride @ 5g/L.
application_method: Immediate whole-field spray as soon as yellow pustules appear
safety_note: Follow the product label and confirm the dose with your local agriculture officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra before spraying.

fertilizer_recommendation: Optimize plant spacing; avoid dense sowing that traps moisture.
pesticide_recommendation: Dust Wettable Sulfur 80 WP @ 3g/L or Triadimefon 25 WP @ 1g/L.
organic_option: Spray 0.5% baking soda (sodium bicarbonate) solution or diluted milk (1:9).
application_method: Foliar spray during early morning before intense sunlight
safety_note: Follow the product label and confirm the dose with your local agriculture officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra before spraying.

fertilizer_recommendation: Maintain balanced N-P-K nutrition; incorporate crop residue after harvest.
pesticide_recommendation: Spray Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 1ml/L or Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2.5g/L.
organic_option: Crop rotation with legumes; foliar application of biofungicide Trichoderma.
application_method: Foliar spray at whorl stage and pre-tasseling stage
safety_note: Follow the product label and confirm the dose with your local agriculture officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra before spraying.

fertilizer_recommendation: Supply potassium nitrate (KNO3) 2% foliar spray to boost boll retention.
pesticide_recommendation: Control vector Bemisia tabaci using Diafenthiuron 50 WP @ 1.2g/L or Pyriproxyfen 10 EC @ 2ml/L.
organic_option: Install yellow sticky traps; foliar spray of Castor oil emulsion or 5% neem extract.
application_method: Spray directed at canopy underside where whiteflies congregate
safety_note: Follow the product label and confirm the dose with your local agriculture officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra before spraying.

fertilizer_recommendation: Apply bio-fertilizer Azotobacter and enrich soil with organic matter.
pesticide_recommendation: Sett treatment with Carbendazim 50 WP @ 1g/L for 30 minutes before planting.
organic_option: Hot water treatment of setts at 52°C for 30 minutes; rogue out infected stools.
dosage: 1 gram per liter of water for cane sett soaking
application_method: Pre-planting dip treatment of sugarcane seed setts
safety_note: Follow the product label and confirm the dose with your local agriculture officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra before spraying.

fertilizer_recommendation: Balanced basal fertilizer application; avoid delayed planting.
pesticide_recommendation: Spray Hexaconazole 5 EC @ 1ml/L or Azoxystrobin 23 SC @ 1ml/L.
application_method: Spray at flowering and pod filling stages upon initial detection
safety_note: Follow the product label and confirm the dose with your local agriculture officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra before spraying.

fertilizer_recommendation: Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation; ensure good row-to-row ventilation.
pesticide_recommendation: Spray Metalaxyl + Mancozeb 72 WP @ 2.5g/L with a wetting sticker agent.
organic_option: Spray Copper Oxychloride @ 3g/L or Garlic-chili extract.
dosage: 2.5 grams per liter of water + 0.5ml sticker agent
application_method: Foliar spray with sticker agent because onion leaves have waxy cuticles
safety_note: Follow the product label and confirm the dose with your local agriculture officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra before spraying.

fertilizer_recommendation: Apply potassium and calcium to thicken fruit cell walls and improve resistance.
pesticide_recommendation: Spray Azoxystrobin 23 SC @ 1ml/L or Difenoconazole 25 EC @ 0.5ml/L.
organic_option: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 10g/kg; rogue diseased fruits.
application_method: Foliar spray during fruit setting and ripening stages
safety_note: Follow the product label and confirm the dose with your local agriculture officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra before spraying.
